run_filter_pdb_val_mmcifs: run the CLI script to filter mmCIF assembly files into a curated PDB validation dataset
filter_num_tokens: filter an mmCIF object based on a maximum token count threshold
filter_num_chains: filter an mmCIF object based on a maximum number of chains threshold
prefilter_target: pre-filter an mmCIF target by release date, token count, chain count, and resolution
filter_structure_with_timeout: filter a single mmCIF structure file with timeout and save the filtered output
filter_structure: filter a single mmCIF structure file with error handling and cleanup on failure
